name: Calendar
summary: A month grid (layout grid) for choosing a day or a range of days.

anatomy.purpose: Month and year with previous and next buttons.

variants.name: Inline vs popup
variants.use: Inline for scheduling; popup from a date field.

whenToUse: Dates where seeing the month matters.
whenNotToUse: Birthdays and far-away dates: use three fields.
Time only: use a time input.

keyboard: Arrow keys move by day and week.
accessibility.focus: Focus ring on the focused day.
notes: Selected state needs more than color: filled shape.
Disabled days stay visible with aria-disabled.
Let people also type the date.
